value.name: Asha hides the folded sheet
value.description: Asha slides the folded page farther under her cuff so the paragraph naming the house rests against her wrist.
evidence: lifted her hand from the corner of the page, glanced once at the empty hall where Daniel had gone, and slid the folded sheet the rest of the way under her cuff so that the paragraph naming the house lay against the inside of her wrist

value.name: Asha senses Lucia approaching
value.description: Asha notices the house sounds and the approaching footsteps of Rosa and Lucia, realizing Lucia is coming down carrying something hidden against her chest.
evidence: The study felt larger without Rosa in it; the cup on the tray had stopped steaming, and the small sounds of the house, a radiator tick, the give of a board overhead, arranged themselves into a count Asha did not want to be keeping.
Then there were the footsteps she had been listening for, two sets, light and quick on the service treads at the back of the kitchen, Rosa's measured and Lucia's a half-beat behind
Asha understood without seeing them that Lucia was coming down with one hand pressed flat to her chest over whatever she had carried upstairs and not put down since

value.name: Asha delays turning to the inner door
value.description: Asha keeps her wrist on the desk and waits to turn toward the inner door so Lucia cannot easily refuse the moment.
evidence: Asha kept her wrist where it was on the desk and did not turn toward the inner door yet, because turning too soon would make the moment into something Lucia could still refuse

value.name: Rosa ushers Lucia into the study
value.description: Rosa enters first and guides Lucia into the study with a hand at her back, while Lucia carries something folded under her blouse.
evidence: Rosa came through the inner door first, her hand at the small of Lucia's back, steering her past the jamb the way she might have guided her through a hot kitchen
and the girl crossed into the study with one hand pressed flat against her chest where the cloth of her blouse showed the corner of something folded underneath

value.name: Asha confronts Lucia with a question
value.description: Asha turns to Lucia, meets her eyes, and quietly asks what she has brought them.
evidence: Asha did not lift her wrist from the page yet; she only turned her head, slowly, until she had Lucia's eyes, and asked under her breath what she had brought them

value.name: Lucia stops in response
value.description: Lucia halts at Asha's question, signaling the start of a tense exchange.
